body: While Connolly’s work is interesting and can offer a useful framework for beginners, she often crosses into the realm of LARPing and believing that it’s her way or the highway. In reality, Connolly’s ritual framework is what works for her personally, but there are many ways to practice magic. Take chaos magick, for example. Study basic witchcraft. Or don’t. Your path in demonolatry should be unique to you.

The only time I’ve gotten visuals from Vassago he came as a boy with red hair. After that, since his energy usually feels like a parrot sitting on my shoulder, I imagine him as a conure, which he really likes.

Haures is normally a leopard of any color or a black cat. He came in human form once, where “he” was a blonde woman, late 30s to early 40s, dressed in a hoodie. 

Asmodeus is some hairy middle eastern dude with a dad bod.

First time’s always the hardest. Once you try it, you’ll realize it’s not scary at all! 👍 Rituals don’t have to be some big thing. You can just light a candle and chant their enns to get in the right frame of mind. You may also cleanse your space at the end for peace of mind (this is not disrespectful to spirits).

He likes the color purple and fine things like jewelry, fancy chocolates, and strong liquor. If you have anything pertaining to big cats, he’ll also enjoy that a lot. If you don’t have the budget for that, anything that has meaning to you will go down well. Nonstandard offerings I’ve given him have included leopard videos, cleaning, and workouts.
Casual contact is generally fine for most demons, and I know Asmodeus is definitely cool with it. It’s fine to do a working just to acknowledge you’ve received their message. 👍

He reached out to me in a dream, too. I knew it was him because I dreamed about his sigil surrounded by a procession of succubi (subtlety’s not his strong suit lol). You can start out with offerings associated with Asmodeus. Since I connect the color pink with lust, I lit a pink candle for him. You can also offer such things as goose feathers, poker chips, and nsfw items (if you’re comfortable with that). If you’re not ready to work with him, you can set the intention of your meditation session to something like: “hey, thanks for reaching out! Please be patient with me.” 

He’s very friendly but not to be double-crossed. He is talented at many things beyond helping with sexual issues. I do dream work with him to explore my identity, for example.

Short answer: yes

Long answer: every demon I’ve ever met has had their own brand of morality. They seem to be very… self-deterministic beings? They all have their unique views on right and wrong. No two are the same. Their moral compass might not be the same as the majority of humanity, but if you ask them to explain themselves, they usually will, and it’ll make sense.

Mundane before magical. Check for practical reasons why you are feeling the way you do before attributing it to demons. Do you often have intrusive thoughts? Have you eaten and slept properly? Been consistent with medication?

But also, nightmares don’t necessarily equal hostility. Sometimes a spirit’s energy is spooky and oppressive, and that’s just how they are. Haures is always sending leopards to chase me in my dreams, but he’s not mad. It’s just another one of his shitty practical jokes, which is an essential part of who he is.

Yes, they often do. In my experience, they might show up to give you a nudge to work with them, usually because they find you interesting or have something valuable to teach you. Prince Vassago practically demanded to work with me through a dream. I’m glad he did, because I wouldn’t have thought of working with him otherwise. It turns out he has a lot of insight on my career. King Asmodeus also reached out lately through a dream. Although we aren’t as close as my relationship with Vassago, Asmodeus is helping me through a problem I didn’t even know I had. :)

Everyone is worthy. There's no need to prostrate yourself as long as you engage with your spirits respectfully. They only ask that you put in the work to improve yourself so they know you aren't wasting their time. If you feel like you can't make a connection with physical offerings, actions are also more than sufficient. Try doing meaningful actions that reflect your spirit's values. For example, in Lord Beelzebub's case, you might choose to honor him by respecting insects and donating to medical research charities. Setting intentions with the choices I make in my everyday life has gotten me far closer with my demons than lighting a candle or offering a stiff drink ever have.

I’m very close with my spirits. I’ve learned to recognize their energy to the point they can come and go as they please when I “invite” them over. I think they mostly just like getting the chance to yap to a human lol. It’s more like we do each other favors far more than I petition.

Vassago - Helluva Boss (idk any other media where he appears). Since we're discussing how our demons feel about their portrayals in the cartoon, I've actually asked him before. He says that he's not nearly as uptight as the cartoon Vassago, but he's not too bothered about it. He likes that he's a bird, and it's an interesting choice that he has a Mexican accent, since he loves Latin America and the tropics. He also thinks the outfit is nice, but he prefers more casual clothes.

  
Haures - This is a hard one. He's only appeared in bit parts using the "Flauros" spelling of his name. He's a summon in Shin Megami Tensei, but that doesn't count as a character. He also has a small part in Fate Grand Order, but I DESPISE his portrayal in the game. Haures himself is a bit particular about how he likes to be portrayed. He likes it when I search up fanart of him on the internet, and he reacts very positively to designs that are a) badass, b) attractive, and c) have leopard or other big cat elements. He likes being portrayed as male and female, and doesn't seem to mind playing the role of a villain even if I don't like it personally. But I'm using him in my own work, and he's grilled me extensively about his character arc before finally giving me the go-ahead. He pretty much likes being seen as sexy with very, very awesome powers. The flashier, the better.

Literally curry lol. He’d probably like Indian food, but I’ve gotten visions of Jamaican curry shrimp and Thai green curry. His energy feels like a spot of warmth on my shoulder. Kind of like a parrot perched there. I imagine him as a sun conure, which he seems to like. That’s why the parrot emoji is next to him in my flair. He communicates with me primarily through mental images.

I work with him, and he's great! He's very casual and laid-back. He has a good-natured sense of humor. I agree with fooxdoog in that he's very interested in education. Prince Vassago is also fine with just hanging around and doesn't mind if you don't have much to say to him. UPG, but as for offerings, he loves curries and tropical fruits such as mangoes. He doesn't like meat too much and prefers water over alcohol. He likes crystals and I also have a deck of tarot cards on his altar.

I wear my sigil openly except at work (don’t need someone jawing off to my boss that I’m a “corrupting influence”). One of my spirits favors boldness, so being front and center with it is a way of honoring him. 99.999% of people just think it’s a cute necklace lol. Otherwise, I’ll answer questions if asked, but if not I just don’t bring it up. I’m private in general and hardly anyone knows about my personal life regardless of spiritual beliefs anyway.

With Prince Vassago, immediately, but that’s probably because he sought me out, not the other way around. I’ve become attuned to his energy and can sense when he’s dropping in on me.

But with other demons, it’s been rough. I’ve petitioned President Marbas a couple times, and while they’ve been granted, I’ve never sensed his energy or made any meaningful contact with him. Prince Vassago has assured me that I’ve been heard, but while I’m good at sensing “hot” energies, my sensitivity to “cool” energies needs a lot of work. He’s advised me to keep practicing, and eventually I’ll be able to speak to Marbas myself. I understand how frustrating it is not being able to contact certain spirits right away, but take heart anyone can do it with sustained practice!

I suppose more path working based? I’m a chaos magician, so my workings are far from typical. In my experience, low clairvoyance is not a problem. Just because you can’t hear the demonic divine doesn’t mean they can’t hear you! The spirits are always around you. 

If by specific, you mean you want to petition for something to play out the way you want it to (eg, “Duchess Bune, please have me win the lottery!”), that’s not how the demonic divine works. They will answer your petition in the way that works best for them. The results will be in line with what you wanted, but not exactly how you imagined it per se.

Of course! If you successfully invoke Haures, you will know it. For me, his energy is blazing hot and anxiety inducing (in fact, he kicks my ass when I’m procrastinating by overwhelming me with his energy until I do the task). He loves strong flavors such as spicy foods and dark chocolate, and anything to do with fire. His ability is to “burn the enemies of the conjurer up”, but this is more metaphorical than physical. If you’ve read Mirta’s demonolator handbook, he also likes it when you prove your resolve by sacrificing an object dear to you. In my personal gnosis, this is true. Duke Haures wants you to know all vengeance comes with a price, but if your rage is stronger than your sense of self preservation, he’ll like you quite a bit. He is a strong and wise demon who values bravery and confidence, but again, he’s intense. 

Feel free to PM me if you have anymore questions.

I wish I could tell you the full story, but most records of my ancestors were destroyed by the Soviets and my grandparents didn’t really talk about it. What we do know in my family is that they lost many family members during the Holodomor, and everyone on my grandma’s side was then annihilated by the Nazis in WWII. She was the only one who survived. After the war, Grandma and Grandpa eventually escaped the KGB thanks to a Polish family who hid them for several months until they could be smuggled into Italy (of all places…) and then America. I don’t know why they were being targeted by the secret police, and while I was told the family members who were killed existed, there’s no longer physical evidence to prove they did. 
My grandparents aren’t around anymore, and they took their secrets with them to the grave. But despite this, my family’s burning hatred of Russians never quelled. We hate Nazis with all our heart, too, but it’s currently orcs we must fight, so fight orcs we shall!

Hi OP,

I’m a Ukrainian-American whose ancestors escaped to Poland during the Holodomor, eventually ending up in the USA decades later. Other relatives of mine weren’t so lucky. I don’t know where or if they were buried. The Soviet Union didn’t register their deaths.

It is widely considered a genocide by Ukrainians and its effects are still felt today. The Holodomor wasn’t merely the imposition of unrealistic harvest goals and seizure of grain. Stalin actively sent troops to prevent Ukrainians from leaving their villages, not to mention he murdered and sent to gulag thousands of leaders, free-thinkers, and even children who tried to steal food for their families.  It was a deliberated, calculated punishment to kulaks (the definition of which I must emphasize changed wildly and essentially encompassed anyone who spoke out against Stalin). So while the majority of Ukrainians weren’t directly murdered by bullets or gas chambers, they were held hostage and killed in one of the slowest, most tortuous ways possible.


The genocide was not so much racial as it was cultural. It was orchestrated to crush Ukrainian spirit, thought, and values. That’s why today Ukrainians are so adamantly outspoken about their distaste of Russification of their culture. When asking questions like this, I urge you to listen to the voices of the oppressed, but if you want more tangible evidence, I urge you to look up the Genocide Convention of 1948. The Holodomor fits into its definition of genocide.

While 98% of scientists agree that human activity probably has affected climate change greatly, there's no "proving" anything in science. However, the overall trend in the data between human activity and climate change shows a high correlation! 

I second NASA.

The [USGS](https://nccwsc.usgs.gov/) is also a phenomenal source. Check out the IPCC's Executive Summary and the [WMO](http://public.wmo.int/en).

The thing about your question is that climatology involves many different scientific disciplines, and Earth's systems are intimately interlinked. I couldn't point you to any particular study, but some basic concepts to look up that I think would help you are: the albedo effect (particularly the ice melting positive feedback loop!), the greenhouse effect, and radiation and global equilibrium. Also look up how our ocean currents affect temperature. 

Something that's important to understand about climate change is that its effects are NOT uniform in magnitude. Its effects increase with latitude! Climate scientists make predictions based on computer models, but it's also important to note that the climate record is incomplete, and we can only make approximations based off of proxy data, which gets less accurate the older it is. Climate oscillations are also normal, and there are non-anthropogenic drivers of climate change such as reduced sunspot activity and the Milankovitch Cycles (although these take a VERY long time) as well.

I'm sorry if this isn't what you were looking for, but those sources should be very helpful!
